lines: The morning you wore light makeup, you who never do
Caught between beginning and end
We made a promise I can't forget
I'll give you a bouquet
My precious one, my precious one
No matter what words I line up
They'll never become the truth
So today I'll give it, a bouquet the color of tears, to you
If there'd been no hidden struggles, no loneliness, day after day
If it had all been nothing but fun
I could have lived without ever knowing love
I'll give you a bouquet
The things I want to say, the things I want to say
There must be mountains of them
But they'll stay known to God alone
So today I'll give it, a bouquet the color of tears, to you
More than two arms can hold
Thank you for all those dazzling scenes
Even when the whole world was rain
Your smile was my sun
Even if it doesn't reach you now
It's the truth all the same
Hold me, just once, before goodbye
I'll give you a bouquet
My precious one, my precious one
No matter what words I line up
They won't be enough to praise you
So today I'll give it, a bouquet the color of tears, to you
To you, to you
